state "Job (persisted state, not a Python state-machine class)" as J $PROC {
 state "status" as Life {
  [*] --> queued : handle_command(submit)

  processing --> done : finish [live && verified primary]\n/ Attempt=succeeded
  processing --> failed : finish(error) [live]\n/ Attempt=failed

jobs.status is only queued / processing / done / failed.
All claim/finish/retry/repair/redirect transitions require deleted_at IS NULL.
Cancel preserves status and terminal Attempt states; queued/processing Attempts become cancelled.
Snapshot exposes status="cancelled" when deleted_at is set. Tombstone prevents later claim or retry.
